admissionInfo.text: Complete ENGL 2010 Intermediate Academic Writing and 30 hours of college-level courses other than French with a minimum GPA of 2.0 Complete lower division French courses ( FREN 1010 Beginning French I , FREN 1020 Beginning French II , FREN 2010 Intermediate French I , and FREN 2020G Intermediate French II or receive the equivalent through experiential credit (does not apply to native speakers). Students with significant residency abroad should register for FREN 3050 Advanced French as a first course toward the minor. Be admitted to a bachelor degree program at UVU.
